Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment uses chemical cross-linking (CXMS) with DSS to probe protein conformation. While not a traditional 'complexome' (interactome) study, CXMS is routed via complexome/structural modifiers in Stage 4. The search parameters explicitly define the cross-link and monolink mass shifts for Lysine (K).

scope: The DSS-modified GPR110-HA was pulled down with HA antibody and the DSS-modified monomeric protein was separated by SDS-PAGE and subjected to liquid chromatography-mass spectrometric analysis after in-gel tryptic digestion
The cell lysate was incubated with 40 µL of HA antibody (Santa Cruz Biotech., Cat #:7392) overnight followed by additional 4-h incubation with 40 µL Dynabeads protein G beads at 4 °C.
the immunoprecipitated GPR110 was eluted by incubating with 50 µL of lysis buffer containing 1 mg/mL HA peptide (ThermoFisher Scientific) at 30 °C for 20 min.

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The material analyzed by MS was GPR110 specifically isolated from cell lysates via immunoprecipitation (HA antibody and Protein G beads) and further purified by SDS-PAGE band excision.

base_candidates_ranked.reason: The experiment used LTQ-Orbitrap XL in data-dependent acquisition (DDA) mode and Progenesis QI for label-free quantitation (LFQ) of biological triplicates.

modifier_candidates_ranked.reason: The study explicitly uses chemical cross-linking mass spectrometry (CXMS) with the DSS cross-linker to identify intramolecular lysine-lysine pairs.

workflow: Cross-linking of expressed GPR110 was carried out in cells with or without synaptamide treatment using disuccinimidyl suberate (DSS).
The acquired spectra from biological triplicate were loaded (Thermo raw files) into the Progenesis QI for Proteomics software (version 1.05156.29278) for label-free quantitation.
Ten data-dependent MS/MS spectra of most intense ions were acquired in the LTQ-XL ion trap using CID
The cross-linked lysine pairs were identified by xQuest software
differential: Significant changes of the cross-linked peptides were based on p ≤ 0.05 (unpair Student’s t-test) and 1.5 fold-change (synatamide-treated vs control) from biological triplicate.
the cross-linked peptides of GPR110 were further normalized to the GPR110 protein level

Ontology_ProcessingAndDifferential_promp.notes: The analysis is highly site-centric, focusing on the relative abundance of specific cross-linked lysine pairs (e.g., K398-K438 and K783-K852) to infer conformational changes. Standard protein-level LFQ is used as a normalization baseline for these site-specific cross-link abundances.
